title: MOS Envelope
description: The single message format exchanged between every unit in the Marketing OS. Terminal processes, subsystems and the system orchestrator all speak this and nothing else. A unit may only read `payload` for business data; everything else is control plane.

envelope_version.description: Semver of this contract. Consumers MUST reject a major version they do not implement.

trace_id.description: Stable for the whole campaign run. Every log line, ledger row and asset carries it.

tenant_id.description: Hard isolation boundary. Secrets, budgets, storage and ledgers are scoped by it.

brand_id.description: A tenant may run many brands; brand resolves voice, palette, assets and guardrails.

vertical.description: Vertical profile id from registry/verticals. Drives every behavioural default. `generic` is always valid.

locale.description: BCP-47. Drives copy, currency, date format, compliance variant.

intent.description: What the caller wants, in capability-tag terms (e.g. `campaign.launch`, `content.single`, `asset.repurpose`).

stage.description: Position in the system loop. Used for routing, dashboards and replay filters.

idempotency_key.description: sha256(tenant_id + capability + canonical(payload)). A side-effecting capability MUST no-op and return the prior result on a repeat.

deadline_at.description: Absolute wall-clock deadline. A unit that cannot finish before it MUST fail fast rather than start.

autonomy_level.description: Ceiling on what the system may do without a human. Never widened by a downstream unit, only narrowed.

budget.description: Enforced by the cost governor before every billable call. Exceeding the cap fails the span with `BUDGET_EXCEEDED`, never silently degrades.

routing.description: Filled by the decision engine. `requested_capability` is abstract; `implementation` is the concrete spec that ran.

payload.description: Capability-specific body. Validated against the capability's declared input_schema, not here.

provenance.description: Append-only. Every unit pushes exactly one entry. Never rewritten — this is the audit trail an enterprise review reads.
